svg.metadata: {"id": "s090", "name": "宠物医院", "cat": "社会日常", "tags": ["科学", "生命教育", "爱护动物", "社会生活"], "desc": "温馨的宠物医院诊室：淡紫墙面点缀爪印，墙上看片灯显示小狗骨骼，不锈钢诊疗台与无影灯，药品柜、宠物航空箱和狗窝。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [620, 1300]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "logo", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "window", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "xray", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "xray_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "cabinet", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "exam_table", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamp_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "scale", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "carrier_bed", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "paw_trail", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#F1ECFB", "wall2": "#E2D9F4", "paw": "#CDBFEE", "wains": "#8FD3C8", "wains2": "#6FBFB2", "floor1": "#F5EDE0", "floor2": "#E3D4BE", "metal": "#C9D2DA", "metal2": "#9AA8B6", "cab": "#FFFFFF", "cab2": "#E4E9EE", "teal": "#4FB3A9", "xray": "#2B3542", "xray2": "#BFE9FF", "bone": "#FFFFFF", "carrier": "#F2A65A", "carrier2": "#D9883E", "bed": "#F28B9A", "bed2": "#E06A7E", "toy": "#F7C55E", "jar1": "#F28B9A", "jar2": "#7FC4E8", "jar3": "#F7C55E", "jar4": "#8ED081", "lamp": "#FFF3C4", "leaf": "#5FAE74", "leaf2": "#8FD39A", "pot": "#FFFFFF", "win1": "#A6DCF7", "win2": "#E8F7FF"}}
